thread:
zara: Quick q — planning to expose the new Console beta toggles (hidden/limited access) for console.beta_ui_v2. Need alignment on canary audience, guardrails, and comms before I flip exposure in prod. Any blockers?

derek: +1 to being conservative. Recommend admin-only hidden toggle first, then a canary rollout to orgs tagged 'beta' at 5%. We should require opt-in via settings page, not auto-enable.

maya: Also add RBAC check (only users with role:product_beta can see the toggle), and require audit logs for every toggle change. Support needs the ability to force-disable per-org.

ash: From infra: implement a kill-switch at the routing layer so we can short-circuit the new UI at edge if we see cascading failures. Rollout policy suggestion: 5% orgs -> 25% -> 100% over 3 manual gates (48h observation windows). Make all gates manual.

olivia: I'll own comms + support playbook. We should prepare a short banner in Console explaining "Beta feature — opt-in" and a rollback FAQ. Also prep a ticket template for support to escalate.

zara: Great — for telemetry, can we agree on a minimal metric set? Thinking: active_users, ui_errors, avg_latency, JS_exceptions, and a quality/regression probe (prompt that hits the new flow).

derek: Metric names: 
- console.beta_ui_v2.active_users
- console.beta_ui_v2.errors_total
- console.beta_ui_v2.ui_latency_p50/p95
- console.beta_ui_v2.js_exceptions
- console.beta_ui_v2.regression_probe_failures
Add alert thresholds: errors_total spike > 3x baseline or p95_latency increase > 50% -> page oncall and auto-disable canary.

maya: Add audit fields we need: changed_by, reason, change_reason_id (link to PR or ticket), previous_state. Also require that any change to rollout_percent has an associated PR link.

zara: I'll add the feature flag config to flags-service. Draft config below — please review:

```json
{
  "flag": "console.beta_ui_v2",
  "default": false,
  "scopes": ["admin_only", "org_tag:beta"],
  "rollout_policy": {
    "initial_percent": 5,
    "steps": [25, 100],
    "manual_gates": true
  },
  "kill_switch_route": "/api/flags/console.beta_ui_v2/kill",
  "audit_required": true,
  "rbac_role": "product_beta"
}
```

ash: Minor ask — add a canary_region field so we can limit to eu-west-1 for initial rollout (latency/infra capacity testing). Also add a feature_toggle_id UUID so infra can map logs easily.

zara: Will add region + UUID. Also planning two UI exposures: (1) hidden admin-only toggle under Settings -> Labs, (2) opt-in banner for eligible orgs.

derek: QA checklist: smoke test, regression probe (automated), manual UX pass, telemetry validation, rollback drill. I'll open a PR that links to the flag change and attach runbook.

olivia: Timeline proposal: create flag + set to hidden admin-only today; enable 5% canary (eu-west-1) next Tue after QA; expand to 25% after 48h if all green; full rollout two weeks post-canary if no regressions. I'll post announcement to beta users 24h before each step.

maya: One more guardrail — require a feature-flagged session header so backend can attribute logs: `X-Feature-Flag: console.beta_ui_v2`. Helps tracing.

infra-bot: Flag created in flags-service: console.beta_ui_v2 (canary=5%, region=eu-west-1). Audit: required. ID=ff-7a3c2b.

zara: Thanks team — I'll (a) add the config to the flags repo, (b) open the PR linking QA checklist and runbook, (c) tag infra for the kill-switch route. If anyone wants to opt in to the admin preview this week, DM me and I'll add you to product_beta. :sparkles:
